a2-66.title: Communicative Challenge: By Bus to the Station
a2-66.scenario: Károly cannot come with Meg to the station next weekend and asks how she will get there. You (Meg) go by bus, and you get off at the next stop.
a2-66.prompt: Tell Károly that you are going to the station by bus and that you get off at the next stop.
cues: Say how you travel to the station
a2-66.target: Busszal megyek a pályaudvarra. A következő megállónál leszállok.
a2-66.english: I'm going to the station by bus. I get off at the next stop.
a2-66.canDo: I can talk about buses, trams and the metro.

a2-67.title: Communicative Challenge: A Pass, Please
a2-67.scenario: At the ticket machine Meg wants to buy a pass for the trip. You (Meg) ask for a pass, ask the price, and ask whether it is valid for a month.
a2-67.prompt: Ask for a pass, ask how much it costs, and ask if it is valid for a month.
cues: Ask whether it is valid for a month
a2-67.target: Egy bérletet kérek. Mennyibe kerül? Egy hónapra érvényes?
a2-67.english: I'd like a pass. How much does it cost? Is it valid for a month?
a2-67.canDo: I can buy a ticket or a pass.

a2-68.title: Communicative Challenge: When Does It Leave?
a2-68.scenario: Meg checks the timetable before leaving. You ask when the bus leaves, and when it arrives at the station.
a2-68.prompt: Ask when the bus leaves and when it arrives at the station.
cues: Ask when it arrives at the station
a2-68.target: Mikor indul a busz? Mikor érkezik a pályaudvarra?
a2-68.english: When does the bus leave? When does it arrive at the station?
a2-68.canDo: I can ask when a bus or tram departs and arrives.

a2-69.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Number?
a2-69.scenario: Meg is planning her route to the station and asks Károly which bus number to take. Then you tell him that you transfer to tram number 4 at Blaha Lujza Square.
a2-69.prompt: Ask Károly which-numbered bus you take, and tell him that you transfer to tram number 4 at Blaha Lujza Square.
cues: Ask which number bus to take
Say where you transfer and onto which tram
a2-69.target: Hányas busszal megyek? A Blaha Lujza térnél átszállok a négyes villamosra.
a2-69.english: Which bus number do I take? At Blaha Lujza Square I transfer onto tram number 4.
a2-69.canDo: I can talk about changing lines.

a2-70.title: Communicative Challenge: How Do I Get There?
a2-70.scenario: Meg is going to Nyugati station alone and asks Károly for the way. You ask how to get there, and tell him your plan: first by bus, then you change to a tram.
a2-70.prompt: Ask Károly how you get to Nyugati station, and tell him your plan: first by bus, then you transfer to a tram.
cues: Ask how to get to the station
Describe your plan in order: bus, then tram
a2-70.target: Hogyan jutok el a Nyugati pályaudvarra? Előbb busszal megyek, aztán átszállok villamosra.
a2-70.english: How do I get to Nyugati station? First I go by bus, then I transfer to a tram.
a2-70.canDo: I can ask how to get to a place by public transport.

a2-70-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Ticket and Timetable
a2-70-consolidation.scenario: Meg arrives at the bus stop. You (Meg) ask for a ticket and ask when the bus leaves for Nyugati station.
a2-70-consolidation.prompt: Ask for a ticket, and ask when the bus leaves for Nyugati station.
cues: Ask when the bus leaves for the station
a2-70-consolidation.target: Egy jegyet kérek. Mikor indul a busz a Nyugati pályaudvarra?
a2-70-consolidation.english: One ticket, please. When does the bus leave for Nyugati station?
a2-70-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about buses, trams and the metro, and say how I travel using -val/-vel.
